houseRulesConfig.intro: Guests are expected to follow your rules and may be removed from Airbnb if they don't.
houseRulesConfig.petsNote: You can refuse pets, but must reasonably accommodate service animals.
houseRulesConfig.additionalRules: Please turn off the AC when you leave. Kindly take care of the furnishings. Remember to do your dishes. Please take out the trash before departure. No illegal substances are allowed on the premises. No smoking! A $300 fine will apply. Parties and events are not allowed

houseManual.title: Smart Home
steps: Control supported devices using Google Home.
Say "Hey Google…" followed by your request.
Examples: turn on the lights, turn off the AC, play music.

houseManual.title: Water Dispenser
steps: Switch on the power at the back before use.

houseManual.title: Water Heater
steps: Available only in the master bathroom.
Turn on the hot water tap.
Please allow a few minutes for the water to heat.

houseManual.title: Toiletries
steps: Complimentary shampoo, body wash, and towels are provided.

faqs.a: Check-in starts at 2:00 PM. The end time is flexible — message us on Airbnb if you need to arrive outside the usual window.
Checkout is strictly at 12:00 PM. Our cleaning team arrives promptly at noon to prepare the home for the next guest.

faqs.q: How do I enter the property?
faqs.a: Use the keypad at the main entrance. Enter your PIN code followed by the # key. Keep your PIN confidential.

faqs.q: How do I use Google Home?
faqs.a: Say "Hey Google" followed by your request — for example, turn on the lights, turn off the AC, or play music.
Guests may use the swimming pool and gym at the clubhouse. The approximate fee is USD $5 per person.
Reconnect to the VITIS 3/3 network using the password in the Guide tab. If issues persist, message us on Airbnb.
Hot water is available in the master bathroom only. Turn on the hot water tap and allow a few minutes for the water to heat.

faqs.q: How do I contact the host?
faqs.a: Please contact us anytime through Airbnb messaging if you need assistance. We won't be available in person during your stay.
